summary: All four purpose outcomes still pass. The earlier definition, merge-permission, framing, head-commit, and provenance fixes remain intact. The pacing objection remains unresolved: tightening the opener does not fix the separate 7.48-second narration gap before the closer, and repeating that the hold is deliberate does not establish its instructional value.

issues.problem: The supplied cue schedule leaves 7.48 seconds between “release tag through” and the closing narration. The destination shot carries “Passed: head commit,” but that relationship has already been explained by cue 7. Engineers spend roughly one-sixth of the clip holding on a takeaway they have already received. The latest rebuttal changes the opener, not this interval.
issues.fix: Keep the music timing, but use this interval for a complete visual recap above the caption band: “Enabled lanes → one report → gate on the head commit → merge or release tag.” Retain the destination diagram underneath so the hold reinforces the whole flow rather than only its final branch.

thirty_second_test.reason: The opening identifies the toolkit category; CHANGE.md establishes configuration and protected refs; the diagram and narration explain enabled-lane aggregation and head-commit gating; the closing narration explicitly credits the walkthrough skill with the diagram.

purpose_test.outcome: What change fabric is: skills and hooks for coding agents that decide when a change may land
purpose_test.reason: 002-logo-open-middle.jpg and 003-logo-open-end.jpg state “skills and hooks for coding agents.” The cold-open narration explains that a passing gate permits the change to merge, supported by the gate-to-destination diagram.

purpose_test.outcome: That one CHANGE.md per repo holds the config and the protected branches and tags
purpose_test.reason: 007-change-md-start.jpg through 009-change-md-end.jpg say “One file per repo” and explicitly identify protected branches and tags. The example shows change_config and protected_refs containing main and tag:v*.

purpose_test.outcome: That every enabled lane feeds one report and a gate on the head commit before a merge or release tag
purpose_test.reason: 011-gate-flow-middle.jpg shows five lanes converging into “One report.” The gate-flow narration specifies every enabled lane, recording the result for the head commit, and allowing only a pass through. 012-gate-flow-end.jpg visibly connects “Passed: head commit” to merge and release-tag paths.

purpose_test.outcome: That this clip itself is made by the walkthrough skill, diagram scene included
purpose_test.reason: The logo-close narration explicitly says “Made by the walkthrough skill from one storyboard, diagram and voice included.” 013-logo-close-start.jpg through 015-logo-close-end.jpg identify cf:walkthrough.
